title: Vergrim's Vexation (Quest)
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Sally Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Vergrim's Vexation! Then Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Another Journey

Zone: Vergrim's Vexation

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Sally Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Vergrim's Vexation! Then Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

The further depths of the dungeon are calling you, young Dungeon Runner. Past the caves and ruins of Algernon and beyond the untamed hinterlands of Algor's Terror-Dome lies the domain of Vergrim, an ancient Whisker prophet. His allies are many and his powers are great.

You will find the portal to Vexation Station on Algor's Terror-Dome - Level 5. Alternatively, rumors abound of a teleporter that will allow a solo adventurer to be transported from Algor's lair to Vexation Station. Search for this teleporter once you have defeated Algor.

Return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston when you have accomplished this task.

Turn-in:

Well done. The lands of Vergrim are ripe for conquering.

Objectives:

  • Locate Vexation Station
  • Locate Vergrim's Vexation

Level range: 15–30
